task_assigned.subject: You were assigned a task: {taskTitle}
task_assigned.body:
Hi {recipientName},

{actorName} assigned you a task: "{taskTitle}".

Open it to see the details and get started.

task_submitted.subject: A task was submitted for review: {taskTitle}
task_submitted.preheader: {actorName} finished a task and is waiting on you.
task_submitted.body:
Hi {recipientName},

{actorName} submitted "{taskTitle}" for your review. Approve it or request changes when you have a moment.

task_approved.subject: Your submission was approved: {taskTitle}
task_approved.body:
Hi {recipientName},

Good news — {actorName} approved your submission for "{taskTitle}". The task is now complete.

task_revision_requested.subject: Revisions requested on: {taskTitle}
task_revision_requested.body:
Hi {recipientName},

{actorName} reviewed "{taskTitle}" and asked for some revisions before approval. Open the task to see what's needed.

task_cancelled.subject: A task was cancelled: {taskTitle}
task_cancelled.preheader: {actorName} cancelled a task you were on.
task_cancelled.body:
Hi {recipientName},

{actorName} cancelled "{taskTitle}". No further action is needed.

task_reassignment_requested.subject: Reassignment request: {taskTitle}
task_reassignment_requested.preheader: {actorName} asked to hand a task back.
task_reassignment_requested.body:
Hi {recipientName},

{actorName} requested to be reassigned from "{taskTitle}". Open the task to approve or reject the request.

comment_mentioned.subject: You were mentioned in a comment
comment_mentioned.body:
Hi {recipientName},

{actorName} mentioned you in a comment on "{taskTitle}". Open the task to read and reply.

comment_created.subject: New comment on: {taskTitle}
comment_created.body:
Hi {recipientName},

{actorName} added a new comment on "{taskTitle}".

deadline_approaching.subject: Deadline approaching: {taskTitle}
deadline_approaching.body:
Hi {recipientName},

A quick reminder — "{taskTitle}" is due {dueDate}.

overdue.subject: Task overdue: {taskTitle}
overdue.body:
Hi {recipientName},

"{taskTitle}" was due {dueDate} and is now overdue. Please update its status or contact the assigner.

onboarding_approval.subject: Welcome to {companyName} — your account is approved
onboarding_approval.body:
Hi {recipientName},

Your invitation to join {companyName} has been approved. Sign in to complete your profile and get started.

new_employee.subject: New teammate at {companyName}: {newUserName}
new_employee.preheader: Say hi to a new colleague.
new_employee.body:
Hi {recipientName},

{newUserName} just joined {companyName}. Drop by to say hello.

leave_reminder.subject: Upcoming leave: {leaveDate}
leave_reminder.preheader: Reminder for your scheduled time off.
leave_reminder.body:
Hi {recipientName},

This is a reminder that you have scheduled leave starting {leaveDate}. Make sure your tasks are handed off before then.
